name: oxiploitability-mcp
description: Sourced, evidence-aware CVE research from NVD, EPSS, KEV, OSV.dev and CVE.org.
long_description: Look up how exploitable a CVE is. From the NIST NVD: description, every CVSS score with its attack vector, privileges and user interaction, CISA's SSVC decision (exploitation none, poc or active), CWEs, affected products with version ranges, and references with exploit links first. From FIRST EPSS: the probability of exploitation in the next 30 days. From CISA KEV: whether the CVE is known exploited, with the due date and ransomware use. It also lists the CVEs affecting a product, package, vulnerability nickname, SBOM, lockfile or container image, using NVD, OSV.dev and CVE.org, ranked by KEV status and EPSS. Every finding names its source and links to its record, so answers can be cited. Runs locally; an optional NVD API key raises the NVD rate limit. This product uses the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.
